"""RoboPaint episode record. All geometry comes from target RGB and camera calibration.
Actions and observed proprioception are archived under output/actions.
"""
import sys, json, time, os
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
OUT=Path('/app/output');(OUT/'actions').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
Z=.02020
QUAT=[0,1,0,0]
class Painter:
 def __init__(self):
  self.r=Robot();self.obs=self.r.get_obs(cameras=['practice_cam'],video='none');self.pos=self.obs.group('tcp_pose',now=True)[:3];self.n=len(list((OUT/'actions').glob('*.npz')))
 def send(self,xyz,note=''):
  a=np.c_[np.asarray(xyz),np.tile(QUAT,(len(xyz),1))]
  for i in range(0,len(a),190):
   aa=a[i:i+190];self.n+=1
   np.savez(OUT/'actions'/f'{self.n:04d}.npz',poses=aa,dt=.05,note=note)
   res=self.r.submit('ee_pose',aa,dt=.05,cameras=['practice_cam'],video='none',note=note)
   json.dump(res.meta,open(OUT/'actions'/f'{self.n:04d}.json','w'))
   self.pos=aa[-1,:3].copy()
   print(self.n,note,'steps',res.meta.get('control_steps'),'left',res.meta.get('time_left_s'),'actual',res.group('tcp_pose',now=True)[:3],flush=True)
   if res.stopped or res.done: raise RuntimeError(str(res.meta))
  return res
 def move(self,p,speed=.04,hold=.3,note='move'):
  p=np.array(p);n=max(1,int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(p-self.pos)/speed/.05)))
  a=np.linspace(self.pos,p,n+1)[1:];a=np.r_[a,np.tile(p,(int(hold/.05),1))];return self.send(a,note)
 def lift(self): self.move([*self.pos[:2],.05],note='lift')
 def dip(self):
  self.lift();self.move([-.10,.153,.06],speed=.12);self.move([-.10,.153,.023],speed=.025,hold=.5,note='ink dip');self.lift()
 def photo(self,name):
  o=self.r.get_obs(cameras=['practice_cam','canvas_cam','scene_cam'],video='none');o.save(str(OUT/name))
  for c,im in o.last.items():Image.fromarray(im).save(OUT/name/f'{c}.png')
  return o

def calibrate():
 p=Painter();p.dip()
 for i,dep in enumerate([.0005,.001,.002,.004,.008]):
  x=.0-i*.028
  p.move([x,-.158,.05],speed=.1)
  p.move([x,-.158,Z-dep],speed=.015,hold=.4,note=f'pressure {dep}')
  p.move([x,-.210,Z-dep],speed=.012,hold=.2,note=f'line {dep}')
  p.lift()
 p.move([-.21,0,.12],speed=.1);p.photo('calibration')
if __name__=='__main__':
 if len(sys.argv)>1 and sys.argv[1]=='calibrate':calibrate()
